label: quality management system
definition: A system that the provider must have in place to ensure compliance with Article 17.
source_quote: have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17

label: documentation
definition: The documentation that the provider must keep as referred to in Article 18.
source_quote: keep the documentation referred to in Article 18

label: logs
definition: The logs automatically generated by high-risk AI systems that the provider must keep when under their control.
source_quote: keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems as referred to in Article 19

label: conformity assessment procedure
definition: The relevant conformity assessment procedure that the high-risk AI system must undergo prior to being placed on the market or put into service.
source_quote: ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure as referred to in Article 43, prior to its being placed on the market or put into service

label: EU declaration of conformity
definition: The declaration that the provider must draw up in accordance with Article 47.
source_quote: draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47

label: CE marking
definition: The marking that the provider must affix to the high-risk AI system or its packaging/documentation to indicate conformity.
source_quote: affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation

label: registration obligations
definition: The registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1) that the provider must comply with.
source_quote: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1)

label: corrective actions
definition: The necessary corrective actions that the provider must take as required in Article 20.
source_quote: take the necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20

label: demonstration of conformity
definition: The demonstration that the high-risk AI system complies with Section 2 requirements upon a reasoned request by a national competent authority.
source_quote: upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2

label: accessibility requirements
definition: The accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882 that the high-risk AI system must comply with.
source_quote: ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882
